title: 27° Congreso Argentino de Columna 2026 — 50° Aniversario SAPCV / 1° Congreso Ítalo-Argentino de Columna
organizer: Sociedad Argentina de Patología de la Columna Vertebral (SAPCV)
description: Three-day congress marking the 50th anniversary of SAPCV, held jointly with the 1st Italo-Argentine Spine Congress. Program includes precongress offerings from EUROSPINE, Instituto Rizzoli, and AO Spine, covering pediatric and adult deformity, trauma, cervical pathology, endoscopy, artificial intelligence, infections, tumors, bone health, workshops, Meet the Expert sessions, and a Young Surgeons Committee course.

title: XLII Congreso Latinoamericano de Neurocirugía — CLAN Panamá 2026
organizer: Federación Latinoamericana de Sociedades de Neurocirugía (FLANC) and Asociación Panameña de Neurocirugía y Cirugía de Columna
description: Latin American Neurosurgery Congress expected to bring together more than 1,000 neurosurgeons and health professionals from Latin America, the Caribbean, and beyond. Ten specialty modules, precongress courses, and free paper submissions; spine surgery is one of the covered subspecialties given the co-organizing role of Panama's neurosurgery and spine-surgery association.

title: 10° Congreso de la Sociedad Dominicana de Cirugía de Columna con V Curso Internacional SILACO
organizer: Sociedad Dominicana de Cirugía de Columna (SDCC), with the Sociedad Iberolatinoamericana de Columna (SILACO)
venue: Live Aqua Punta Cana Convention Center
dateNote: Verified via local press coverage (elCaribe) — no dedicated congress microsite was found.
description: Held for neurosurgeons, spine surgeons, orthopedists/traumatologists, physiatrists, pain physicians, physiotherapists, and residents. Opening day featured a Research Project Workshop and a Pediatric Scoliosis module, including AI-in-medicine applications; the broader program covers scoliosis, trauma, degenerative disease, tumors, endoscopic surgery, bone weakness, infections, cervical pathology, and revision surgery.

sources.notes: Local press coverage, used because no official congress microsite was found.

title: 20º Congresso da Sociedade Brasileira de Coluna (CSBC 2026)
dateNote: Exact dates confirmed via a secondary source (iot.com.br); the official microsite's crawled text did not itself surface the dates.
description: Brazil's national spine congress, organized by the Sociedade Brasileira de Coluna (founded 1994, uniting orthopedic and neurosurgical spine surgeons). Thematic tracks include adult and pediatric deformity, endoscopic spine surgery, pain management, trauma, tumors, navigation and robotics, spinal infections, complication prevention, and hands-on cadaver courses.

title: XXVI Congreso Anual AMCICO 2026
organizer: Asociación Mexicana de Cirujanos de Columna, A.C. (AMCICO)
description: Annual congress of the Mexican Association of Spine Surgeons (AMCICO). AMCICO brings together orthopedic surgeons and neurosurgeons specializing in spine surgery, including those in academic training.

title: AO Regional Courses Latin America 2026
organizer: AO Foundation / AO Spine Latin America
dateNote: Ten educational activities running across the week; most courses (including the AO Spine Regional Course) are concentrated Aug 18–21, with an AI-focused cross-clinical seminar on Aug 19.
description: Third edition of the AO Foundation's regional educational event in Latin America, combining ten courses and one cross-clinical seminar on AI in clinical research across trauma, spine, craniomaxillofacial, veterinary, sports, and reconstructive surgery. Expected to draw over 100 international faculty and roughly 600 participants.

title: 5° Congreso Regional SCHOT
organizer: Sociedad Chilena de Ortopedia y Traumatología (SCHOT) — Centro Norte Regional Branch
dateNote: General regional orthopedics/traumatology congress, included because SCHOT maintains a standing spine committee (Comité de Columna) contributing to its scientific programming.
description: Regional congress of the Chilean Society of Orthopedics and Traumatology, held with activities extending to La Serena, organized by SCHOT's Centro Norte regional branch.
